svg.aria-label: Six stages of photogrammetry: overlapping photos, matched features, camera positions with a sparse point cloud, a dense point cloud, a triangle mesh, and a textured model of an owl figurine.
svg.text: Photogrammetry: from photos to a 3D model
The app does stages 2 to 6. Your photos decide whether they can work.
Walk around it: every spot in 3+ photos
Corners and specks found in two photos
Rays from matched features cross in 3D
The texture map gives it its look
